footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: Run the Chardonnay Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck in both modes; your Bari 8★ and Chardonnay 10★ clear every threshold.
changes: Arena attack and defense: Chardonnay Bari deck, Chardonnay in Macaron's slot.
Retire the Rye Rockstar lineup: Rye now loses to 5★+ Bari decks.
Rumble defense: Chardonnay for Macaron, Cherry Cola back for Doughnut King.
Rumble pets: King Choco Drop, Holy Baby Drop, Icy Birdie or Hot Doggie.

Keep the six-haste preset to test: 서신우 runs six with crit RES.
Skip the Eternal Lv.95 package: fixed Lv.95 pieces, below your Lv.110+ set.
Pomegranate's beam: Chardonnay and Milk take it first; keep Bari next in ATK.
Captain Milk with Armor Repair + Passion Pay; keep Milk in mirrors.
Level the PvP twelve as account levels unlock 119 and 120.
Attack late and revenge: defenses still lose to equal attackers.

arena.lede: Regular, per-server Arena. The Chardonnay Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck leads; Rye decks lose to it from Bari 5★.
arena.caveat: crumb.gg's meta page is the only ladder data; its sample is unstated. Haste counts and the weapon's crit line are argued.

rules.title: Format
rules.body: Auto-battle: your attack team against another player's saved defense. No bans, picks or rounds.

rules.title: Teams
rules.body: Attack and defense are set separately. Refreshing the opponent list can cost crystals.

rules.title: Auto-repeat
rules.body: Continuous challenge (auto-repeat attacks) since 2026-09-10.

rules.title: Team size
rules.body: 12 cookies, 3 pets, a captain and two merc perks per side.

rules.title: Battle length
rules.body: About 60 s. Near the end '종료 임박' appears and damage rises.

rules.title: Matchmaking
rules.body: Per server, five opponents: one stronger, two similar, two weaker. Names and power show; gear doesn't.

rules.title: Tickets
rules.body: One Arena ticket every 2 h; a free opponent refresh every 30 min.

rules.title: Seasons
rules.body: About two weeks each, closing 12:00 KST. Season 6 runs 10-08 16:00 to 10-22 12:00 KST.

rules.title: Tiers
rules.body: Champion 1–3 go to ranks 1–3. Master 4 to Grand Master 1 promote by absolute rank.

rules.title: Top tiers
rules.body: Grand Master 1/2/3 need 3,000 trophies and the top 5/10/30; Elite Master 1–5 need 2,000 and the top 75–750.

rules.title: Season reset
rules.body: Diamond 2 and up restart at 700–1,300 trophies by tier; Diamond 3 and below keep half.

rules.title: Hidden defenders
rules.body: Defenses hide cookies by tier: 4 at Grand Master and Champion, 3 Elite Master, 2 Master, 1 Diamond.

rules.title: Lineup codes
rules.body: Since 10-08 a lineup copies and pastes as a code, Arena defense included.

rules.title: Points
rules.body: An attack win pays +15 to +25. A failed defense costs 1–5.

rules.title: Revenge
rules.body: Revenge attacks from the defense log recoup more than the loss.

rules.title: Rewards
rules.body: Wins pay Fame (Boss, Element, Crit DMG levels) and Victory Medals.

rules.title: Promotion rewards
rules.body: First promotions pay diamonds: 4,000 for Elite Master 1 and Grand Master 3, 6,000 for Grand Master 2.

rules.title: Stats that count
rules.body: Level, promotion, codex, gear, plate, sugar runes and pet ownership effects (in-game help).

rules.title: Stats that don't
rules.body: Breakthrough, Stellar Link and the labs don't count, so displayed power overstates PvP strength.

rules.title: Merc perks
rules.body: Disputed: the 10-08 help explains how they apply, but its text isn't captured; players still doubt them on defense.

rules.title: Level cap
rules.body: Level counts. Since 10-08 the cap is Lv.120, which needs account level 200.

rules.title: Power bracket
rules.body: The PvE power bracket is fixed at 100% in PvP.

rules.title: Season buffs
rules.body: No season passive in regular Arena. Season 1 skipped the defense's DR; fixed from Season 2.

rumble_arena.lede: Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나, 와레나): the cross-server arena. Season 2's top 100 run the Oven–Bari team with Chardonnay.
rumble_arena.caveat: Season 2's third day: scores are low and few defenders hide yet. Usage counts are lower bounds.

rules.title: Format
rules.body: The same auto-battle as Arena, run beside it, in one cross-server pool.

rules.title: Presets
rules.body: Its own 5 presets for attack and defense. Levels can't be changed there.

rules.title: Team size
rules.body: Up to 12 cookies and 3 pets. Empty slots are legal.

rules.title: Battle length
rules.body: About 60 s with a visible countdown.

rules.title: Season 1
rules.body: 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-08, battles closing 12:00 KST. Final #1 7,292; 100th about 3,805.

rules.title: Season 2
rules.body: Battles 10-08 14:00 to 10-21 12:00 KST. No Season 3 listed yet.

rules.title: Season 1 buff
rules.body: Charge cookies +30% max HP; all cookies and summons +30% DR. Both teams.

rules.title: Season 2 buff
rules.body: The same as Season 1: Charge cookies +30% max HP, everyone +30% DR, both teams.

rules.title: Season buffs
rules.body: A season can carry its own passive; Season 2 kept Season 1's.

rules.title: Tickets
rules.body: 5 free a day, refilled at 00:00; extras cost 1,000 mileage each.

rules.title: Points
rules.body: The win value shows before the fight. A held defense gives +1 or +2; a lost one −1 to −5.

rules.title: Promotion gems
rules.body: First promotions pay gems: out of Diamond 2 1,200, out of Master 2 1,800, into Elite Master 5 2,000, into Grand Master 3 4,000.

rules.title: Medals
rules.body: +175 medals per win or held defense at Master and Elite Master, up from +125.

rules.title: Anonymous opponents
rules.body: Above 2,000 points opponents show as 익명의 도전자, with power and levels as ???.

rules.title: Hidden defenders
rules.body: Defenses hide cookies by league: 1 at Diamond, 2 Master, 3 Elite Master, 4 Grand Master and Champion. Defense logs show all 12.

rules.title: Revenge
rules.body: Revenge screens show 25–39 points; one player says a revenge paid only +3.

rules.title: Shop reset
rules.body: Every two seasons, about four weeks: it didn't reset for Season 2.

rules.title: Leagues
rules.body: Platinum, Diamond, Master 5–1, Elite Master 5–1, Grand Master 3–1, Champion 3–1.

rules.title: Top leagues
rules.body: Grand Master 3/2/1 need 3,000 points and top 100/30/10; Champion 3/2/1 need 3,200 and top 3/2/1.

rules.title: Middle leagues
rules.body: Elite Master 1–5 need 2,000 points and the top 5–40%; Master 1–4 the top 50–80%.

rules.title: Reward cliff
rules.body: Ranks ~101 to ~2,300 sat in Elite Master 1 at Season 1's end, all on the same reward.

rules.title: Daily rewards
rules.body: Daily mail: 2,500 medals to the top 100, 2,000 to Master top 5–30%.

rules.title: Shop
rules.body: Medals buy dungeon keys, chocolate, syrup, Stella rune rewards and a random box.

rules.title: Stats that count
rules.body: Players say stars and gear count, breakthrough and labs don't. No official text.
